videos.t: Superconducting Levitation - Millennium Falcon Demo
videos.desc: In this superconducting levitation demo, multiple Yttrium Barium Copper Oxide (YCBO) strips are cooled using liquid Nitrogen until they began superconducting. The YCBO superconductors are then embedded into a 3D printed Millennium Falcon model and levitated on a neodymium magnetic track with custom circuit boards displaying the trailing "energy field" as a practical (real-life) special effect.

videos.t: Do Masks Really Work? (With LMFAO)
videos.desc:
🥼Instructions for replicating this science demonstration 🥼

1. Buy some agar petri dishes 🧫 like these: https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B01LW3PI4N/

2. Do not open the petri dishes until you are ready to do the demonstration. It is very, very easy to contaminate them.

3. Find a way to hold the petri dish near your mouth, such as leaning it against a box on a table and then sitting at the table. 

4. Put on a mask 😷 (or not) depending on which part of the demo you want to do.
